import { taxFor } from "./tax";

export function buildInvoice(items: Item[], region: string): Invoice {
  const subtotal = items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.price * i.qty, 0);
  return { items, subtotal, tax: subtotal * taxFor(region) };
}
